# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

 

## Tricia Fitzgerald's Story

Meet the Fitzgerald family: Mom, dad, and 6 kids. Life with chronic conditions is not simple, but
with CVS Health by their side, managing chronic conditions becomes a little… simpler.

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# **Apollo 24|7 - Your Most Trusted Healthcare Brand**

Apollo 24|7 is the largest multi-channel digital healthcare platform in India, created with a vision
of eliminating flexibility blockages from the healthcare industry. We believe in making healthcare
affordable to everyone by combining analytic excellence, affordable cost, and extensive research
with advanced technology. Apollo 24|7 is a single online platform where you have access to a wide
range of services such as online pharmacy, [*online doctor consultations*][97], and diagnostic [*lab
tests at home*][98]. We also provide expert solutions for chronic conditions and COVID-care with a
secured digital vault, where you can safely upload all your medical reports. 

## **The Smart Choice for Your Health is Here**

Make the best decision for your health by choosing Apollo 24|7. Here’s why you can count on us:
* 40 years of legacy in the healthcare industry
* 24x7 availability of doctors
* More than 10 million diagnostic tests each year
* 2000+ collection centres and 100+ laboratories
* High quality diagnostic solutions 
* Fast and accurate test report results
* Several medical specialties under one roof
* Order medicines and book tests online with ease
* Digitised health queries

**Ask a Doctor Online 24/7**
Online doctor consultations take place through online doctor chat, call, or video call. This helps
you to talk to doctors online from the comfort of your home by simply choosing a doctor from
different specialties. Avail personalised solutions for any health problem with prompt online doctor
consultation with Apollo 24|7.
* Safe and secure platform
* Video and chat options

**Online Doctor Consultation - Now at Your Fingertips**
The demand for doctors is expected to increase as new medicines allow people to live longer.
However, there are several ways to reach out to a doctor without the need to visit a hospital or
clinic, all thanks to technology. With the online facility available, doctor consultations have
become easier, and you can get the right health care. Online doctor consultations with 5000+ top
medical doctors are available at Apollo 24|7. Video call or chat with expert doctors from 100+
medical specialties, including | [Dermatology][99] | [Gynaecology][100] | [Paediatrics][101] |
[Psychiatry][102] | [General Physicians][103] | [Gastroenterology][104] | [Dietetics][105] | [Ent
Specialists][106] | and more, in just 15 minutes.

Benefits of choosing online doctor consultations:
* Save time, money, and effort.
* No need to travel. 
* Most convenient option to choose from, and helps in early diagnosis.
* Online doctor consultations are confidential and safe.
* No risks of infections.

## **Apollo Hospitals**

Apollo 24|7 is a part of Apollo Hospitals. [Apollo Hospitals][107] was established in 1983 by Dr.
Prathap C Reddy. It incorporates over 10,000 beds across 70 hospitals, over 4000 pharmacies, 172
primary care and diagnostic clinics, and 148 telemedicine facilities spread across 13 countries.
Apollo Hospitals has touched billions of lives by offering exceptional clinical outcomes.

Milestones of Apollo Hospitals:
* 40 Years of legacy and credibility in the healthcare industry. 
* NABL certified multi-channel digital healthcare platform.
* World’s best medical specialists.
* Largest & trusted branded healthcare network.
* Advanced healthcare technology.
   

**Pharmacy Simplified with Apollo 24|7**
Apollo pharmacy is the most credible and established online pharmacy in India. It delivers 100%
original medicines and products. Apollo pharmacy is believed to offer super-fast home delivery for
all the healthcare essentials. Explore our broad range of  products such as baby care, personal
care, wellness, lifestyle, health, and nutrition categories online with ease. 

Rapid deliveries of medicines are available online at Apollo Pharmacy. In some cities, deliveries
are done in less than 24 hours.
* Get health credits on purchasing medicines and products.
* Alluring deals on medicines and other products.
* A broad range of medicines and essential healthcare products to choose from.
* Authentic and top-notch quality products.

# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

## Pipeline

AS OF APRIL 30, 2026
* 50 Compounds in development
* 40+ Disease areas being studied

Our pipeline targets areas where we can deliver transformative medicines — for patients who need
them most.

# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

## Pipeline

AS OF APRIL 30, 2026
* 50 Compounds in development
* 40+ Disease areas being studied

Our pipeline targets areas where we can deliver transformative medicines — for patients who need
them most.

#### Smart Medication Management

[Our products][26]

### [ComeoCare][27]

##### [Belgian market leader for oncology treatment management][28]

ComeoCare is a smart platform for complex medicinal treatment management that connects multiple
departments and all medical staff involved. Our solution is used in over 30 Healthcare Institutions
in Belgium and Switzerland. 

[Read more][29]

### [Our commitment to healthcare][30]

For over two decades, as a trusted partner, we have been at the forefront of supporting healthcare
organizations and driving evolutions in the industry. 

Our unwavering commitment lies in developing customized and innovative solutions that enable
healthcare providers to leverage, secure, and maintain their applications effectively.

[Read more][31]

### [Living our values][32]

By embracing our core values, we create a thriving work environment characterized by positivity and
collaboration. 

Our dedication to fostering meaningful connections with clients allows us to work together towards
shared success.

[Read more][33]

### [News And Stories][34]

#### This is the title
* June 23, 2026
  
  #### [ADKA 2026][35]
  
  We spent three days at the ADKA-Jahreskongress in Düsseldorf alongside B. Braun, showing the
  closed loop for oncology end to end: prescription and preparation in ComeoCare, administration
  with OncoSafety, right down to programming the pump with exactly what the physician ordered — and
  a feedback loop that brings the nurses' notes straight back for the next cycle.
  
  [Read more][36]
* June 23, 2026
  
  #### [Chapter IV][37]
  
  Did you know that Comeocare can automatically generate reimbursement attestations ? Chapter IV
  medications is time-consuming and error-prone. Thanks to the interface between ComeoCare and
  Amaron's Workflower, this process can now be fully automated.
  
  [Read more][38]
* June 18, 2026
  
  #### [Maribor][39]

## Together, we save kids faster!

# We focus on areas of unmet need

### *Every* child deserves safe treatment.

We are dedicated to ensuring that every child diagnosed with cancer has a safe and effective
treatment option. Focusing on pediatric cancers with insufficient or ineffective treatment options
is a priority of our research strategy. Our unique funding strategy focuses on addressing areas of
unmet need, including:

• Cancers with the lowest survival rates

• Limited or most damaging treatment options

• Populations that are underserved, including adolescents and young adults

# Our unique funding strategy is delivering results

### Our research funds groundbreaking, lifesaving breakthroughs.

CureSearch is armed with the best-in-class advisory councils that ensure research is engineered to
advance to the marketplace. This accelerated research is quickly leading to new advancements,
including:

**•** A novel drug for Ewing sarcoma in pediatric clinical trials

**•** A clinical trial for high-grade glioma that is now enrolling patients

**•** A new treatment for recurrent, refractory medulloblastoma in pediatric clinical trials

# Our projects are 7x more likely to advance

### **Speed is critical, because children with cancer can't wait.**

60% of preclinical research projects funded through our Acceleration Initiative have advanced to
clinical trials, more than doubling the typical success rates for new cancer therapies entering the
clinic.

# We ONLY fund translational research

### A "bench to bedside" focus is critical.

There is a significant funding gap for translational, preclinical, and early-phase clinical trials.
CureSearch only funds translational research projects with the strongest potential to become a new
treatment and quickly reach patients. In the last 5 years, we’ve awarded more than $12 million in
research grants for projects dedicated to developing new therapies for kids with cancer.

**Simply put, if a project isn't on an accelerated path to new drug development, *we don’t fund
it.***

## Together, we save kids faster!

# We focus on areas of unmet need

### *Every* child deserves safe treatment.

We are dedicated to ensuring that every child diagnosed with cancer has a safe and effective
treatment option. Focusing on pediatric cancers with insufficient or ineffective treatment options
is a priority of our research strategy. Our unique funding strategy focuses on addressing areas of
unmet need, including:

• Cancers with the lowest survival rates

• Limited or most damaging treatment options

• Populations that are underserved, including adolescents and young adults

# Our unique funding strategy is delivering results

### Our research funds groundbreaking, lifesaving breakthroughs.

CureSearch is armed with the best-in-class advisory councils that ensure research is engineered to
advance to the marketplace. This accelerated research is quickly leading to new advancements,
including:

**•** A novel drug for Ewing sarcoma in pediatric clinical trials

**•** A clinical trial for high-grade glioma that is now enrolling patients

**•** A new treatment for recurrent, refractory medulloblastoma in pediatric clinical trials

# Our projects are 7x more likely to advance

### **Speed is critical, because children with cancer can't wait.**

60% of preclinical research projects funded through our Acceleration Initiative have advanced to
clinical trials, more than doubling the typical success rates for new cancer therapies entering the
clinic.

# We ONLY fund translational research

### A "bench to bedside" focus is critical.

There is a significant funding gap for translational, preclinical, and early-phase clinical trials.
CureSearch only funds translational research projects with the strongest potential to become a new
treatment and quickly reach patients. In the last 5 years, we’ve awarded more than $12 million in
research grants for projects dedicated to developing new therapies for kids with cancer.

**Simply put, if a project isn't on an accelerated path to new drug development, *we don’t fund
it.***

## Your support changes the odds!

#### Our mission is to end children's cancer by driving targeted and innovative research with
#### measurable results in an accelerated time frame. The research we fund is delivering safer, more
#### effective children's cancer treatments. Thank you for your support!

## Get involved to end children's cancer

[hike]

### Ultimate Hike

Tell children’s cancer to “take a hike” and join us for a life changing, lifesaving adventure.
Choose from eight of the country’s most iconic trails.

[fundraise]

### Volunteer Opportunities

Lend your time, skills, expertise and passion in support of our shared mission to end children’s
cancer.

[gold-c]

### Host Your Own Fundraiser

Create your own fundraising event to help end childhood cancer; from golf tournaments to backyard
BBQ’s, the possibilities are endless!

## An unparalleled research strategy

#### **Our Scientific and Industry Advisory Councils are comprised of experts at the top of their
#### fields, and validation of a research project by our Scientific Review Committee speaks volumes
#### in the global children's cancer arena.**

[
[Brenda Weigel]
][70]

### [Scientific Advisory Council][71]

Led by Brenda Weigel, MD, MSc
The Scientific Advisory Council includes leading pediatric oncologists who set the academic
priorities for CureSearch research initiatives and evaluate projects on scientific merit.
[
][72]

Progress FW 2007.]
][73]

### [Scientific Review Committee][74]

Led by Stephan Sallan, MD
The Scientific Review Committee provides rigourous peer review of research proposals, evaluating:
scientific merits, innovation, unmet need and clinical impacts.
[
][75]
[
[Jeffrey Skolnik, MD]
][76]

### [Industry Advisory Council][77]

Led by Jeffrey Skolnik, MD
The Industry Advisory Council includes leaders from the largest global oncology and biotechnology
companies who review potential research projects for clinical and regulatory feasibility.
[
][78]

## Our Corporate Partners

[LESS AND MORE Logo-01]

The team at [LESS+MORE][79] generously offered their services pro bono in 2023 to design a stunning
suite of refreshed Ultimate Hike creative. This rebrand reflects our commitment to prioritize the
growth of Ultimate Hike as our largest annual fundraising campaign.

[Mattel-brand-logo]

Through a partnership with Mattel, CureSearch is honored to provide [**Brave Barbie**s][80] to
childhood cancer patients. Hair loss is a common side effect of chemotherapy and radiation therapy
treatments. Brave Barbie helps children better understand their hair loss and provides a "friend"
through treatment and beyond.

[Iron Hill logo]

"We’re proud to be a long-time partner of CureSearch with 10+ years of support for children’s cancer
research. This relationship demonstrates to both the employees and customers of Iron Hill Brewery &
Restaurant that we care deeply about the wider community that we serve. We know CureSearch is hard
at work finding new treatment options for kids and together we are helping to put an end to
childhood cancer."

#### Kevin Finn

Founder and President, Iron Hill Brewery & Restaurant
[Kiewit logo]

"Our annual Jakefest events honor the memory of my son, Jake, who passed away after a heroic fight
with rhabdomyosarcoma. Kiewit has partnered with CureSearch because they're uniquely positioned to
accelerate the pace of finding new drugs for kids. Through the generosity of Kiewit's employees,
their spouses, friends, relatives, and our gracious business partners, over $7M has been raised for
CureSearch. We could hardly have imagined eighteen years ago the outpouring of goodwill this event
has brought."

#### Harry Koenigs, Jake's Dad

Retired Area Manager, Kiewit
[Busy Bee logo]

“Busy Bee is proud to be a sponsor for CureSearch! It’s our privilege to support such an incredible
organization that’s work, mission and drive will benefit ALL of us. We are thankful for the
brilliant and hardworking teams that work tirelessly to end childhood cancer!”

#### Elizabeth Waring

President, Busy Bee
[Parexel logo]

“As a leading clinical research organization, Parexel is committed to making a difference in
patients’ lives and collaborating with organizations who also keep the patient at the heart of
everything they do. Parexel is delighted to sponsor CureSearch’s National Walk and join this
important effort to provide research funding to find new safe and effective treatments for children
with cancer.”

#### Katherine Minson

Senior Medical Director, Parexel

therapies in stroke, pulmonary fibrosis, and other areas of unmet need.

[Featured Articles][25]

improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they
require careful early planning around usability, safety, regulatory requirements, compatibility,
manufacturing, and scale-up.

absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

[Featured Articles][29]

### Precision Drug Development][30]

response patterns to tumor biology, and support more predictive, biomarker-guided strategies for
precision cancer treatment.

native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

dosage forms, scale-up risks, regulatory demands, and accelerated timelines by connecting projects
with CDMO partners that offer specialized expertise, integrated workflows, and scalable
manufacturing support.

[Featured Articles][19]

Advances in inhaled drug delivery are improving how therapies reach the lungs, with innovations in
formulations, devices, biologics, and digital tools helping expand treatment options for respiratory
diseases.

[Featured Articles][21]

### [CAR T CELL THERAPY - The Rise of Scalable Allogeneic CAR T: Shaping a New Era in Oncology][22]

Allogeneic CAR T therapies are helping move oncology toward more scalable, off-the-shelf treatment
models that could expand access, support earlier intervention, and bring advanced cell therapy
closer to community cancer settings.

[Featured Articles][23]

### [EXECUTIVE INTERVIEW - Dr. Michalis Papadakis Founder & CEO Brainomix][24]

Brainomix founder and CEO Dr. Michalis Papadakis discusses how AI-powered imaging is helping drug
developers improve clinical trial design, identify meaningful treatment effects, and advance new
therapies in stroke, pulmonary fibrosis, and other areas of unmet need.

[Featured Articles][25]

### [DRUG-DEVICE COMBINATION PRODUCTS - Incorporating Self-Administered Drug-Device Combination
### Products Into Clinical Trials Can Bring Outsized Challenges & Outstanding Rewards][26]

Self-administered drug-device combination products can bring major benefits to clinical trials,
improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they
require careful early planning around usability, safety, regulatory requirements, compatibility,
manufacturing, and scale-up.

[Featured Articles][27]

### [DRUG DELIVERY - Improved Prediction of Food Effect on Oral Absorption][28]

Dissolution-permeation testing is helping drug developers better predict how food affects oral drug
absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

[Featured Articles][29]

### [DRUG DEVELOPMENT - Drug Combination Screening in Oncology: Advancing Predictive Strategies for
### Precision Drug Development][30]

Drug combination screening is helping oncology developers identify synergistic drug pairs, connect
response patterns to tumor biology, and support more predictive, biomarker-guided strategies for
precision cancer treatment.

[Featured Articles][31]

### [SINGLE B CELL ANTIBODY DISCOVERY - Improving Therapeutic Candidate Selection in Drug
### Development][32]

Single B cell antibody discovery is helping improve therapeutic candidate selection by preserving
native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

[Featured Articles][33]

### [CHEMOENZYMATIC LIGATION - Enabling Scalable, Sustainable Oligonucleotide Manufacturing][34]

Chemoenzymatic ligation offers a scalable, more sustainable path for oligonucleotide manufacturing
by combining SPOS fragment production with enzymatic assembly to improve purity, reduce impurities,
and support growing demand for nucleic acid therapeutics.

[Featured Articles][35]

### [CONTROLLED RELEASE - Precision in Every Dose: Advancing Controlled Release for Small Molecule
### Therapeutics][36]

Controlled release technologies are helping small molecule therapeutics deliver more consistent drug
exposure, improve patient adherence, reduce dosing frequency, and support more precise treatment
through advanced formulation and delivery strategies.

[Featured Articles][37]

### [BIOCATALYSIS - Biocatalysis Without Barriers for Efficient Small Molecule Process
### Development][38]

Masha Kononov and Reuben Carr examine both the promise and the practical constraints of biocatalysis
in modern drug substance development, as well as the role of contract research, development and
manufacturing organizations (CRD-MOs) in meeting the evolving demands of modern small molecule
synthesis.

[Contract Services,][39] [Featured Articles][40]

### [SPECIAL FEATURE - PFS & Parenteral Manufacturing: Rapid Growth of Injectables Places

[Contract Services,][42] [Featured Articles][43]

are poorly soluble (BCS Class II and IV), the scCO2 is taking an aim to find the desired solutions
to help improve the bottleneck in the industry.

[Featured Articles][45]

## About

### ESMO Open

[[Cover Image - ESMO Open, Volume 11, Issue 7]][78]

*ESMO Open* is the European Society for Medical Oncology's online-only, peer-reviewed open access
journal, dedicated to publishing high-quality medical research and educational content from all
disciplines of oncology, with a focus on innovative clinical and translational cancer research. The
Journal aims to maximize industry networks to curate and disseminate preclinical or translational
data. We hope to bridge the gap between basic research and clinical applications, facilitating the
translation of groundbreaking discoveries into tangible advancements in cancer care. Our platform
will serve as a catalyst for innovation, nurturing the dialogue between academia, industry, and
clinical practice.

### ESMO

[ESMO  Opens in new window][79]   is the European Society for Medical Oncology. Representing over
50,000 members globally, ESMO is a reference for oncology education and information.

Founded in 1975, ESMO has European roots with a global reach. Home for all oncology stakeholders,
ESMO connects professionals with diverse expertise and experience. Its education and information
resources support an integrated multi-professional approach to cancer care, from a medical oncology
perspective.

ESMO seeks to erase boundaries in cancer care, whether between countries or specialities, and pursue
its mission across oncology, worldwide.

[ESMO Guidelines Opens in new window][80]

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

[Founder]
Dmytro Shulha
CEO and Founder of GetProspect

Hi, I’m Dima, founder and CEO at GetProspect.

The idea for GetProspect came after talking with a salesperson friend who struggled to find valid
emails. I realized that the process of finding and organizing leads was time-consuming and
frustrating, and there had to be a better way.

I had experience building SAAS tools and created MVP in just a couple of months. I worked so great,
and demand was so high that it grew very fast. Through hard work and dedication, GetProspect turned
into a successful company with customers all over the world.

We are building an all-in-one platform that will help businesses to find email addresses and leads,
send them, and close deals. Our goal is to build a great company with a startup culture where we are
happy to work and deliver outstanding services that customers will love. We rely on the latest
technologies and trends to bring  innovations to our users.

I hope you’ll feel our love through the product and it will bring true value.

Please, let me know if we can do something even better. 

Show more
[Team]

### Bootstrapped by a small team with a big passion for tech

At Kaiser Permanente, everything works together for one very important cause. You.

Our doctors, hospitals, and health plans are all connected — collaborating seamlessly across

You get convenient access to care that fits your life. Talk to a health care professional from

## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

Karnataka - Listed as [**Best Hospital in Whitefield, Bengaluru**][284] (351 ITPL Main Road,
Whitefield Road, Hoodi Village, Bengaluru) , **Women and Children Hospital Bangalore**

## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

# Join Us in Concentrating on the Cure for Osteosarcoma

[DONATE TODAY][34]

## To the OSI, No New Options is Not an Option

There have been no new treatment options approved for osteosarcoma in nearly 40 years. This is not
acceptable to the Osteosarcoma Institute. Our healthcare visionaries, founders, staff, and board
members have all been impacted by osteosarcoma in their personal lives and careers. We are taking on
the persistent problem of osteosarcoma with urgency and a new approach because we care deeply about
this mission.

The mission of the Osteosarcoma Institute is to dramatically increase treatment options and survival
rates in osteosarcoma patients through identifying and funding the most promising and breakthrough
osteosarcoma clinical trials and science. The Osteosarcoma Institute funds breakthrough clinical
trials and science to identify new treatments, and ultimately a cure for osteosarcoma.

[LEARN MORE][35]

> It’s not because it’s the right thing to do, it’s because it’s unacceptable not to do it.
> -Mac Tichenor, OSI President

## Shelter Me: The Cancer Pioneers

A documentary featuring OS Therapies' groundbreaking OST-HER2 immunotherapy, has received two 2025
Daytime Emmy nominations: Outstanding Daytime Special and Outstanding Writing Team for a Daytime
Non-Fiction Program!

This recognition underscores the critical importance of advancing innovative treatments for diseases
like osteosarcoma. Your awareness and support for these pioneers help elevate the conversation
around critical medical breakthroughs.
[View full video][35]

#### Pioneering New Treatments for Osteosarcoma and Other Solid Tumors

Join us in our mission to revolutionize cancer treatment and give hope to those affected by
aggressive cancers.

[Our technologies][36][Clinical trials][37]
[Healthy human cell | OS Therapies]

## Q2 2024 Financial Results

Report available for quarter ending June 30, 2024.

About OS Therapies

#### Breakthrough Cancer Treatment

OS Therapies (OST) is a clinical-stage cancer immunotherapy company dedicated to developing a new
way of activating the immune system to kill cancers that express HER2 like Osteosarcoma, Breast
Cancer, Colorectal Cancer and other solid tumors. With over 30 years of without new treatments in
Osteosarcoma, we are first addressing this urgent need for innovative therapies for both kids and
adults.

We will then expand our lead candidate’s therapeutic development into Breast, Esophageal, Lung,
Ovarian, and Pancreatic cancers.

#### Our Lead Program

Our cutting-edge research focuses on developing HER2 targeted therapies to treat Osteosarcoma and
other cancers. Because of the way our novel cancer immunotherapy works, when we target HER2
expressing cancers, the immune system is able activate killer T cells against all the cancer
antigens the tumor expresses.

## HER 2 Therapies

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

[ View All Internal Medicine ][110]

We’re developing therapies to treat, slow, or prevent disease progression and improve the quality of
life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

##### [ Inflammation & Immunology ][111]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

We look for treatments that provide more than just symptom relief, in order to address the root
cause of chronic inflammatory diseases at a molecular level

[Vaccine graphical thumbnail portrait image 4]

##### [ Vaccines ][113]

[ View All Vaccines ][114]

Vaccines are the single most important innovation in the science of health to significantly reduce
the threat of diseases that were once widespread and oftentimes fatal.

## Rally Foundation for Childhood Cancer Research

Rally, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, empowers volunteers across the country to raise awareness and funds
for childhood cancer research to find better treatments with fewer long-term side effects and,
ultimately, cures.

## Our mission started with one simple question.
## What can I do to help?


## Click here

to watch a two-minute
video on how Rally got started.

Q

## Rally by the Numbers

## 93¢

93 cents of every dollar supports our
mission

## $47.5M

$47.5 million awarded in childhood cancer research grants

## $356M

$356 million advocated and secured in new federal funding

## 148K

148,000 meals provided to families in the
hospital

## Why We Rally

Every day, 47 children in America are diagnosed with cancer, the leading disease killer among kids.
Childhood cancers differ from those in adults, requiring dedicated research. Shockingly, less than
8% of the National Institutes of Health’s budget supports pediatric cancer research.

This is a call to action, urging us to raise awareness, advocate for increased federal funding, fund
research ourselves, provide ﬁnancial support to affected families, and most importantly, offer hope.

Together, we can make a profound impact on the lives of these brave young warriors.

## New to the childhood cancer community?

Rally Foundation for Childhood Cancer Research (Rally) was founded in 2005 by Dean Crowe, who
watched her friend’s child battle brain cancer. She asked,
“What can I do to help?”

We know how important it is for you and your child to be part of a loving community, ﬁnd support and
comfort. Also, we know how important it is for your community to help you. We are here for you, your
family and your friends.

After all, Rally started with a simple question,

### Fitzwilliam Hospital, 23 July 2026

[star rating]

After an intense training and following hiking I was limping and had pain in my knee. Later I had
tight muscles for about a month and nothing helped me. Even after a short walk I had pain in my legs
and could never get muscles relaxed. I made an appointment with Dr Sally Mirtle, and it was my first
ever appointment with a physiotherapist. During 30 mins Sally carefully listened to me, assessed my
legs, made a conclusion about my joints that I never considered before. Then she did a quick massage
of my legs but surprisingly not where I had pain, and not on that particular leg. How surprised I
was when just after this short massage session I could walk back to the station and my legs were
light and it was no pain. Sally gave me a workout plan and explained every exercise carefully. What
I liked was that she didn't give me many exercises, just a few but very efficient. I had a plan of
my hikes and explained to Sally how it is important for me. Because of Sally's plan I managed to do
these hikes though not 2 full days but still managed to be prepared for them quickly, and what is
the most important, Sally's treatment and workout plan allowed me to be prepared for my first
mountaineering training. I was surprised how Sally could see what the problem was, and she knows the
biomechanics of legs so well that asked me to do stretching that I would never expect in my case,
but it really helped me. I also wanted to note her humanity - Sally really wants to help, has high
empathy and kindness. Many thanks, Vera

Oncology Never Had
+0 avoidable waiting
FASTER TREATMENT ACCESS & IMPROVED CASHFLOW
In oncology, delay isn’t neutral. It’s schedule churn, treatment anxiety, and downstream clinical
risk. Where treatment, revenue, and decisions stall behind approvals, follow-ups, and resubmissions,
RISA resolves constraints earlier, compressing the entire cycle forward.
Time-to-treatment reduction
First-pass approval improvement
Cashflow latency reduction

+0 avoidable waiting
EXPANDING THROUGHPUT BEYOND FTE CONSTRAINTS
In oncology, patient volume and care complexity continue to rise while the workforce cannot scale at
the same rate. The bottleneck becomes coordination: work moving across teams, systems, and portals
rather than advancing care. RISA shifts that execution load from people, allowing teams to support
more patients and workflows without increasing FTE pressure.
FTE time reclaimed from repetitive admin work
Reduced operational load on clinical and administrative teams
Single continuous execution flow reducing coordination overhead and delays
Scale across sites, specialities and geographies without linear staffing growth
[Isometric diagram showing a person icon connected to multiple nodes with various lines on a grid
background.]
+0 interpretive VARIANCE
OPERATIONALIZING EVIDENCE & POLICY
Oncology care must align with evolving clinical guidelines and payer policies that vary by plan,
indication, line of therapy, and geography. RISA encodes clinical evidence and payer policy into
executable logic, ensuring clinical intent is consistently supported by the right documentation at
the moment of execution
Guideline-aware execution aligned with NCCN, ASCO, and disease-specific standards
Consistent medical necessity validation across payers and plans
Reduced variability caused by manual interpretation of policy
Resilience to guideline and policy changes
[Central node connected to multiple floating web page layouts via lines on a gray background.]
+0 system fragmentation
INTEROPERABLE EXECUTION ACROSS THE  ECOSYSTEM
Cancer care operates across a dense network of systems. Clinical history, diagnostics, pathology,
imaging, treatment plans, operational updates, and outcomes are created and consumed by different
systems over time; inside and outside the oncology practice.
As care progresses, data must continuously move across this ecosystem to keep clinical and
operational state aligned. When interoperability is limited to read-only access or point
integrations, teams are forced to manually reconcile state across tools.
Bi-directional read/write integration across clinical and operational systems
Interoperability across modern platforms and legacy infrastructure
Reduced manual reconciliation as systems stay synchronized by default

# Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Treat cancer as a fungus
[dr tullio simoncini]

#### Dr. Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Dr. Tullio Simoncini, – oncologist from Rome, Italy – has pioneered sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3)
therapy as a means to treat cancer. The fundamental theory behind this treatment lies in the fact
that, despite a number of variable factors, the formation and spreading of tumors is simply the
result of the presence of a fungus.

[more][7]
[simoncini sodium bicarbonate iv]

#### Sodium Bicarbonate

Sodium bicarbonate, unlike other anti-fungal remedies to which the fungus can become immune, is
extremely diffusible and retains its ability to penetrate the tumor, due to the speed at which the
sodium bicarbonate disintegrates the tumor. This speed makes fungi’s adaptability impossible,
rendering it defenseless.

[more][8]

## General information

[dr tulklio simoncini rome italy]

#### About Dr. Simoncini

Tullio Simoncini is a roman doctor specialising in oncology, diabetology and in metabolic disorders.
He has a strong opposition to any type of intellectual conformity, which is often based on
suppositions without foundation or worse, on lies and falsities.

[sodium bicarbonate IV solution]

#### Sodium bicarbonate

The fundamental reason and the motives that suggest a therapy with sodium bicarbonate against
tumours is that, although with the concurrence of a myriad of variable concausal factors – the
development and the local and remote proliferation of these tumours has a cause that is exclusively
fungin.

[candida albicans]

#### Candida Albicans

Candida in cancer patients is usually interpreted as a consequence of the weakening and of the
exhaustion of the organism because of neoplastic lesions. But candida is not a post hoc but an ante
hoc cause.

[treatment-protocols]

#### Treatment protocols

Dr. Simoncini’s methods have cured people for over 25 years. Many of his patients recovered
completely from cancer, even in cases where official oncology had given up.
The best way to try to eliminate a tumour is to bring it into contact with sodium bicarbonate, as
closely as possible.

# Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Treat cancer as a fungus
[dr tullio simoncini]

#### Dr. Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Dr. Tullio Simoncini, – oncologist from Rome, Italy – has pioneered sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3)
therapy as a means to treat cancer. The fundamental theory behind this treatment lies in the fact
that, despite a number of variable factors, the formation and spreading of tumors is simply the
result of the presence of a fungus.

[more][7]
[simoncini sodium bicarbonate iv]

#### Sodium Bicarbonate

Sodium bicarbonate, unlike other anti-fungal remedies to which the fungus can become immune, is
extremely diffusible and retains its ability to penetrate the tumor, due to the speed at which the
sodium bicarbonate disintegrates the tumor. This speed makes fungi’s adaptability impossible,
rendering it defenseless.

[more][8]

## General information

[dr tulklio simoncini rome italy]

#### About Dr. Simoncini

Tullio Simoncini is a roman doctor specialising in oncology, diabetology and in metabolic disorders.
He has a strong opposition to any type of intellectual conformity, which is often based on
suppositions without foundation or worse, on lies and falsities.

[sodium bicarbonate IV solution]

#### Sodium bicarbonate

The fundamental reason and the motives that suggest a therapy with sodium bicarbonate against
tumours is that, although with the concurrence of a myriad of variable concausal factors – the
development and the local and remote proliferation of these tumours has a cause that is exclusively
fungin.

[candida albicans]

#### Candida Albicans

Candida in cancer patients is usually interpreted as a consequence of the weakening and of the
exhaustion of the organism because of neoplastic lesions. But candida is not a post hoc but an ante
hoc cause.

[treatment-protocols]

#### Treatment protocols

Dr. Simoncini’s methods have cured people for over 25 years. Many of his patients recovered
completely from cancer, even in cases where official oncology had given up.
The best way to try to eliminate a tumour is to bring it into contact with sodium bicarbonate, as
closely as possible.

At Texas Oncology, we're committed to making your cancer care experience as supportive and
empowering as possible.


Our team of compassionate, highly trained oncologists provides comprehensive treatment options
tailored to your individual needs. Whether you're undergoing chemotherapy, radiation, or other
therapies, we’re here to guide you with expertise, respect, and care — every step of the way.

‌

[[Texas Oncology banner image featuring a smiling older male patient holding a cane while a
healthcare provider in blue scrubs places a reassuring hand on his shoulder, conveying compassionate
patient care, with a blue overlay on the left side of the image]][11]
[About Texas Oncology][12]

Texas Oncology’s mission is to provide evidence-based and high-quality care to each patient we
serve, while advancing cancer care for tomorrow.

‌

[[Texas Oncology banner image featuring a smiling young female cancer patient seated across from her
physician at a consultation table, with a clipboard nearby, conveying compassionate and personalized
cancer care, with a blue overlay on the left side of the image]][13]
[Cancer Care][14]

Texas Oncology helps patients navigate their cancer journeys with a highly-skilled care team
featuring physicians, advanced practice providers, pharmacists, and social workers.

‌

[[Texas Oncology banner image featuring a focused female researcher in a white lab coat, safety
goggles, and stethoscope working in a laboratory setting, with a deep blue overlay on the left side
of the image]][15]
[Clinical Trials][16]

Texas Oncology is a leader in groundbreaking cancer research and clinical trials in Texas, paving
the way for new breakthroughs in cancer care.

## Our Specialty Programs

Specialty

### [Medical Oncology][17]

Our medical oncology team specializes in diagnosis, personalized treatment planning, and coordinated
care to support you every step of the way.
Specialty

### [Radiation Oncology][18]

Targeted radiation therapy tailored to your goals for effective, precise cancer care.
Specialty

### [Hematology][19]

Comprehensive care for blood cancers and disorders—anemia, leukemia, and clotting—personalized
treatment close to home.
Specialty

### [Breast Care][20]

Texas Breast Specialists is a group of physicians dedicated to diagnosing and treating diseases and
disorders of the breast – both cancerous and benign.
Specialty

### [Colorectal Care][21]

The surgeons of Texas Colon & Rectal Specialists offer advanced screening, diagnosis, and treatment
for colon and rectal conditions, improving health and quality of life.
Specialty

### [Urology][22]

The physicians of Texas Urology Specialists offer compassionate and comprehensive urology care and
advanced treatments for a wide range of urologic conditions.
Specialty

### [Surgical Oncology][23]

Texas Oncology Surgical Specialists offers comprehensive cancer surgery—biopsies, tumor removal, and
minimally invasive options from skilled surgical oncologists.
Specialty

### [Gynecologic Oncology][24]

Compassionate, advanced surgery and care for ovarian, uterine, cervical, and vulvar cancers.
Specialty

### [Proton Therapy][25]

Targeted proton therapy delivers powerful cancer treatment with fewer side effects—close to home at
Texas Oncology.
[Exterior of a Texas Oncology clinic location at 9750 Hillwood Parkway, featuring a modern building
with large glass windows, wood panel accents, and the Texas Oncology logo displayed prominently on
the stone facade, surrounded by native ornamental grasses under a partly cloudy sky]
We make it as easy as possible to access the care you need. With more than 250 locations, you are
likely to find a provider near where you live and work.

At Texas Oncology, we're committed to making your cancer care experience as supportive and
empowering as possible.


Our team of compassionate, highly trained oncologists provides comprehensive treatment options
tailored to your individual needs. Whether you're undergoing chemotherapy, radiation, or other
therapies, we’re here to guide you with expertise, respect, and care — every step of the way.

‌

[[Texas Oncology banner image featuring a smiling older male patient holding a cane while a
healthcare provider in blue scrubs places a reassuring hand on his shoulder, conveying compassionate
patient care, with a blue overlay on the left side of the image]][11]
[About Texas Oncology][12]

Texas Oncology’s mission is to provide evidence-based and high-quality care to each patient we
serve, while advancing cancer care for tomorrow.

‌

[[Texas Oncology banner image featuring a smiling young female cancer patient seated across from her
physician at a consultation table, with a clipboard nearby, conveying compassionate and personalized
cancer care, with a blue overlay on the left side of the image]][13]
[Cancer Care][14]

Texas Oncology helps patients navigate their cancer journeys with a highly-skilled care team
featuring physicians, advanced practice providers, pharmacists, and social workers.

‌

[[Texas Oncology banner image featuring a focused female researcher in a white lab coat, safety
goggles, and stethoscope working in a laboratory setting, with a deep blue overlay on the left side
of the image]][15]
[Clinical Trials][16]

Texas Oncology is a leader in groundbreaking cancer research and clinical trials in Texas, paving
the way for new breakthroughs in cancer care.

## Our Specialty Programs

Specialty

### [Medical Oncology][17]

Our medical oncology team specializes in diagnosis, personalized treatment planning, and coordinated
care to support you every step of the way.
Specialty

### [Radiation Oncology][18]

Targeted radiation therapy tailored to your goals for effective, precise cancer care.
Specialty

### [Hematology][19]

Comprehensive care for blood cancers and disorders—anemia, leukemia, and clotting—personalized
treatment close to home.
Specialty

### [Breast Care][20]

Texas Breast Specialists is a group of physicians dedicated to diagnosing and treating diseases and
disorders of the breast – both cancerous and benign.
Specialty

### [Colorectal Care][21]

The surgeons of Texas Colon & Rectal Specialists offer advanced screening, diagnosis, and treatment
for colon and rectal conditions, improving health and quality of life.
Specialty

### [Urology][22]

The physicians of Texas Urology Specialists offer compassionate and comprehensive urology care and
advanced treatments for a wide range of urologic conditions.
Specialty

### [Surgical Oncology][23]

Texas Oncology Surgical Specialists offers comprehensive cancer surgery—biopsies, tumor removal, and
minimally invasive options from skilled surgical oncologists.
Specialty

### [Gynecologic Oncology][24]

Compassionate, advanced surgery and care for ovarian, uterine, cervical, and vulvar cancers.
Specialty

### [Proton Therapy][25]

Targeted proton therapy delivers powerful cancer treatment with fewer side effects—close to home at
Texas Oncology.
[Exterior of a Texas Oncology clinic location at 9750 Hillwood Parkway, featuring a modern building
with large glass windows, wood panel accents, and the Texas Oncology logo displayed prominently on
the stone facade, surrounded by native ornamental grasses under a partly cloudy sky]
We make it as easy as possible to access the care you need. With more than 250 locations, you are
likely to find a provider near where you live and work.
